notes.title: Patch notes 1.23
notes.notes:
What's new in version 1.23:
• scattered a deck of cards on the street
• returned the missing posters in the entrance
• tried to remove freezes and shader stutter in each level
• corrected errors in the Portuguese and English translations

notes.title: New Points Shop Items for Neyasnoe
notes.notes:
You can now customize your Steam profile with our new Steam Points Shop Items.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/2435180/]Here they are on Steam Points Shop.[/url]

• 10 animated avatars
• 5 animated avatar frames
• one animated profile background

All are bursting with character and personality. Hope you enjoy.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.19
notes.notes:
What's new in 1.19 update:
• added Christmas Tree and Tulips (only appear in season)
• alcohol dizziness can now be disabled
• camera sway when walking can also be disabled
• edits to sound settings
• gamepad control edits
• small bugfixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.18
notes.notes:
What's new in version 1.18:
• new posters appeared on the city streets
• pixelation is disabled by default
• added +1 rat to first level
• cars at the fourth level spawn and despawn less obviously
• some defective textures have been fixed
• poles go off into the distance
• minor bugfixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.17
notes.notes:
As sometimes happens, a bigger patch is followed by a smaller patch, and that's exactly such case.

What's new:
• removed normal maps from wall ads
• a barely noticeable gap in the factory wall has been eliminated
• settings are set
• minor bugfixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.16
notes.notes:
Patches for Neyasnoe are being made, but we don't write anything about them, and suddenly we were prompted that it would be nice to write patch notes. So, the game is being actively improved. It's version 1.16 already!

What's new:
• there are new cars on the second level
• added excuses for closed doors
• a cat got lost

In addition:
• optimized loading of levels, they slow down less at the beginning
• fixed controller bugs
• the stadium athlete's hands hold tightly to the bar
• minor bugfixes
